object_description: curved five-armed building volume in a park landscape
design_condition: The centrally positioned, five-armed volume is embedded in the park and interweaves open space across the plot, while its constant roof edge makes it appear particularly high where the surrounding terrain slopes downward.

positive.statement: The independent stance strengthens the essential characteristics of the protected townscape.

position.rationale: Broad building placement is anchored to the visible outer mass, with elevations confirming its overall embedded scale.

positive.statement: The curved volume creates an interesting interweaving of open space across the plot boundaries.

position.rationale: Top view clearly shows the five curved arms interweaving open space around a central junction.

positive.statement: The building is cleverly perceived as a collection of smaller volumes within the green urban body.

position.target: smaller volumes within green urban body
position.rationale: Distinct peripheral arms read as smaller volumes distributed around the larger central composition.

positive.statement: The public permeability of the ground floor and the spaciousness of the reception area are particularly welcomed.

position.target: public ground floor and reception area
position.rationale: Ground-level judgment is anchored near the central entry-facing surface, though reception is not distinguishable in the sample.

positive.statement: The garden pockets, entrance and small campus create pleasantly different atmospheres and respectfully engage the existing buildings.

position.target: garden pockets, entrance and small campus
position.rationale: Open pockets around the lower-right arm provide the most plausible sampled anchor for site arrival and garden spaces.

positive.statement: The existing trees are integrated into the overall concept with a high degree of sensitivity.

position.rationale: No trees are distinguishable, so the anchor uses an exposed peripheral landscape zone beside the building.

positive.statement: The architectural expression supports the curved form and is appropriate and largely understandable.

position.rationale: The articulated outer edge and repeated points visibly express the curved mass along the eastern arm.

positive.statement: The vertical pilaster layer creates permeability, intimacy and structural sun protection.

position.rationale: Facade layering is not individually resolved; the eastern perimeter provides the constrained vertical-screen anchor.

positive.statement: The low-invasive conversion of the existing building appears precise and well thought out.

position.rationale: The converted structure is not identifiable, so a separate-looking southwest peripheral volume is used as an approximate anchor.

positive.statement: The intensive green roof makes a valuable contribution to biodiversity.

position.rationale: The roof footprint is visible from above and its constant upper edge is confirmed in elevations.

positive.statement: The proposal is robust in terms of building physics and construction.

position.rationale: The statement evaluates whole-building performance and construction rather than a locatable geometric feature.

negative.statement: The constant roof edge makes the volumes appear particularly high compared with the surrounding street.

position.target: constant roof edge and high volumes
position.rationale: Upper perimeter remains level while the elevation sample shows the roof edge rising prominently above lower terrain.

negative.statement: The longer facade development causes the project to lose economic efficiency.

position.rationale: The elongated eastern and western perimeter arms visibly create extensive facade length.

negative.statement: The arrangement of the treatment rooms was assessed very critically because privacy can hardly be guaranteed.

position.rationale: Interior rooms are absent from the exterior sample; the northeastern arm provides a constrained clinical-zone estimate.

negative.statement: The waiting areas remain separated from the facade, limiting views to the outside.

position.rationale: Waiting areas are not visible; the interior side of the western arm is used as a constrained approximation.

negative.statement: The corridors on the facade are questioned at the laboratory level.

position.rationale: Corridors cannot be resolved, so the narrow interior band beside the eastern facade is used.

negative.statement: The long walk between the office pool and laboratories is impractical and undesirable.

position.target: walk between office pool and laboratories
position.rationale: The circulation issue is anchored to the elongated lower connector visible between peripheral arms.

negative.statement: The future viability of such a specific form was controversially discussed.

position.rationale: The complete interwoven five-arm geometry is directly visible and defines the debated long-term specificity.

negative.statement: The curved shape creates many narrow, angled spaces that are critical for use.

position.rationale: Acute residual spaces are visibly concentrated where the lower-right arm meets the central volume.

negative.statement: The insulation standard on the inner-courtyard facades must be increased, and functional summer thermal protection is lacking.

position.rationale: Courtyard-facing surfaces are inferred around the central void, which is visible but lacks facade-system detail.
